name: What accessibility features should be included in an attached in-law suite for aging parents?
description: Include zero-threshold showers, 36-inch wide doors, reinforced framing for grab bars, comfort-height fixtures, and step-free transitions between rooms.

mainEntity.name: What accessibility features should be included in an attached in-law suite for aging parents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aging-in-place features should be integrated into the framing and rough-in stages of your addition rather than retrofitted later. Key accessibility choices include widening interior doorways to at least 36 inches, eliminating hallway step-downs, and incorporating a zero-entry, walk-in shower with slip-resistant tile and internal wall blocking for grab bars. Comfort-height toilets, lever-style door handles, rocker light switches, and single-handle faucets provide long-term daily convenience. Planning these adjustments early ensures the addition meets current comfort needs while avoiding structural modifications in the future.
